decisions.reason: The E/L height alignment and second-V cap-height hierarchy were already established in message 171. Message 173 pauses composition refinement but does not change the candidate's existing composition values.

The candidate already requires the E and L heights to match the second V's left arm. The new approximate second-V scale changes the source Requirement but does not alter this relational letterform rule.
Message 173 changes the construction and scale of the second V and does not modify the É accent's derivation, geometry, alignment, or locked status.
The approved Hero V remains the unchanged source geometry from which the second V is proportionally reduced; no Hero V attribute is changed.
The second-V scaling instruction implements the existing visual hierarchy without changing any brand-expression goal, tone, positioning, or symbolism.
Proportional reduction preserves the Hero V's terminal geometry and is consistent with the existing shared-terminal rule; message 173 establishes no new terminal treatment.
The source decision concerns black-and-white geometry and hierarchy only and does not change the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
Refining the second V does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
